Child Dies After Falling Into Borewell Despite Extensive Rescue Efforts

A four-year-old child, Nirbhay Singh, died after falling into a 220-foot-deep borewell in Ambala, Haryana. Despite a rescue operation lasting approximately 21 hours, the child could not be saved and was declared dead by doctors. The incident has caused significant grief in the family and the local area, and a case has been registered against three individuals.
